summary: Frontend testing of CR-113 PetpoojaAlternative mobile UX overhaul. All critical features verified on mobile (390px) and desktop (1440px).

minor.issue: 429 rate limit hit during testing (expected in preview env)

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify OTP stage transition due to 429 rate limit on /api/demo-request in preview. Form submit logic in code looks correct (setStage('otp') on success).

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting on /api/demo-request blocks OTP stage testing in preview — not a code bug, just a preview constraint

(3) Validation errors shown on empty submit. (4) Backdrop close works (clicking above sheet closes it). (5) Stat chips lg:hidden works. (6) No sticky bar on /petpooja-alternative. (7) Homepage sticky bar still present. (8) VspCta DemoForm with 6 fields visible. Could not verify OTP transition (429 rate limit).
